{{Top}}
[[File:God.jpg|thumb|right|250px|"...have they?"]]
'''God''' was a [[Deity/Legends|deity]] recognized by some [[Human/Legends|Humans]] that was omniscient and possibly omnipotent. "God" was also a generalized term for any sort of deity. When [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] was captured by [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] along with [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], he expressed that they considered him to be "some sort of god."<ref name="Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

Examples of deities included the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] gods<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species real-world book">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> and the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] gods, called the [[Skyborn]].<ref name="Lost Tribe of the Sith: Skyborn">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Skyborn]]''</ref> [[Darth Andeddu]] was also referred to as the "Immortal God-King of [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]]".<ref name="Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref>

==Notable gods==
The [[Maker/Legends|Maker]] for droids was a god or deity that they believed created intelligent creations out of simple machines or was the first droid.<ref name="Scavenger's Guide to Droids">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

On [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] statues of a [[Goddess of security and safekeeping/Legends|Goddess of Safety]] could be found in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].<ref name="Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref>

The [[Zakuul]] natives worshiped a pantheon of gods known as the [[Six Gods]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref> The so-called Old Ways were generally discarded after the rise of the [[Eternal Empire]].<ref name="KOTFE 11">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=11}}</ref>

The [[Kissai]] worshipped the god [[Typhojem/Legends|Typhojem]], known as the Left-Handed God.<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>

The [[Gods of Age]] were a group of seventeen deities that were worshipped by the [[Fian/Legends|Fia]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Galantos]].<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], including [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], worshipped a pantheon of [[Immortal gods of the Sith/Legends|immortal gods]]. Another pantheon of [[space-gods]]<ref name="Star Wars 1977 6">[[Star Wars (1977) 6|''Star Wars'' (1977) 6]]</ref> was worshipped by the [[Sacred Way/Legends|Sacred Way]].<ref name="Star Wars 1977 7">[[Star Wars (1977) 7|''Star Wars'' (1977) 7]]</ref>
